title: NFL Power Rankings entering Week 8: Vikings are last undefeated team, but are they No. 1?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Power Rankings entering Week 8: Vikings are last undefeated team, but are they No. 1?
sources.description: Minnesota has a championship level defense and Seattle is the only other team with a decent argument for a better group. But the Vikings don't have the balance of other elite NFL teams.
